# Caramel Apple (G4)

Caramel Apple is a pale-yellow Earth-pony mare from Applejack’s extended family in *Friendship is Magic*. Her curly orange mane and tail, green eyes, and **three caramel apples** cutie mark distinguish her from the nearly identical Golden Harvest (Carrot Top). She is **not** the brown stallion Caramel, also sold as Chance-A-Lot. [Character and appearance guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Caramel_Apple).

[![Attribution](https://www.strawberryreef.com/images/graphics/G4/CaramelApple_SR.jpg)](https://www.strawberryreef.com/Index/g4characters.html)  
*Hasbro character art, isolated for the reference gallery by Strawberry Reef.*

[![Attribution](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2023/4/8/2953635/full.png)](https://twibooru.org/2953635)  
*Autumn-fair fan artwork, credited to algoatall on the artwork post; Caramel Apple runs the caramel-apple stall.*

**Name and voice.** Applejack **speaks her name in the 2010 pilot**, so “Caramel Apple” is an on-screen name, not merely a fan nickname. Hasbro’s **2013 Wave 7 blind-bag** figure (#22) also uses it; its collector-card description says she enjoys watching movies with friends. An Enterplay card uses the variant “Caramel Apples” (plural). She has **no verified individual spoken lines or voice-actor credit**; Applejack introduces her, not vice versa. Sources: [pilot transcript](https://mylittlepony.neoseeker.com/wiki/Mare_in_the_Moon_%28episode%29/Transcript) and [merchandise record](https://www.strawberryreef.com/Index/Name/caramelappleFIMmini.html).

**Where to spot her.** *Friendship is Magic* S1E1, *The Last Roundup* (S2E14), *Apple Family Reunion* (S3E8), and *Trade Ya!* (S4E22); she also appears in the 2017 film’s Friendship Festival crowd and in licensed IDW *My Little Pony/Transformers* comics #2 and #4. The Gameloft game gives her a movie-night/pony-oke description. Those are distinct screen, game, and crossover-comic depictions, not evidence of an alter ego. [2017 film crowd still](https://twibooru.org/2313744).

## Important moments

1. **Introduced at the Apple family table** — *Friendship is Magic, part 1* (S1E1). Applejack names Caramel Apple while welcoming Twilight and Spike to a family feast, establishing her identity and family connection. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YKGVFimIl7E) — scene timestamp unverified.
2. **The extended-family reunion** — *Apple Family Reunion* (S3E8; some uploads label it E9). She watches relatives arrive by airship and is later seen departing with Apple Cobbler, marking her as part of the wider Apple clan. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7LwXctUyB0I) — scene timestamp unverified.
3. **Defending Sweet Apple Acres** — IDW *My Little Pony/Transformers: Friendship in Disguise!* #4 (2020; crossover-comic continuity). Discord summons Apple relatives, including Caramel Apple, and the family collectively drives off an Insecticon infestation. [Issue and story summary](https://www.seibertron.com/comics/view.php?comic_id=1828&title=transformers-my-little-pony-friendship-in-disguise-4) — video timestamp not applicable.
